- **Changeset prose:** `23477-revoke-reason-vocabulary.md`, `platform-objects` `patch`, "Description text only"; it says what the diff does.
- **Claim amendment:** the bundles live in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` (the claim guessed an `identity` folder). Open PR #23469 regenerates the same folder; the later lander re-runs the generator.
